== Description ==
English [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (Reflections II Foil)|Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], a [[Dark]] [[Character]] printed by [[Decipher]] as a foil box topper for [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The physical card is photographed in its PSA holder.

== Source and credit ==
